problem_text:
A logistics firm is tasked with distributing seven distinct categories of cargo, each requiring passage through seven sequential handling stages before delivery.  
The revenue generated per ton for each cargo category is as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 14.404 per ton  
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 13.453 per ton  
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 5.949 per ton  
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 19.896 per ton  
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 12.192 per ton  
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 9.792 per ton  
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 15.937 per ton  

The handling duration per ton for each stage is detailed below:  
* For Cargo Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 0.244 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.982 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.396 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.932 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.571 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.793 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.414 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Beta, Stage 1 consumes 0.974 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.257 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.69 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.892 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.819 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.873 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.646 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.541 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.684 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.175 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.81 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.194 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.491 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.092 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Delta, Stage 1 consumes 0.24 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.753 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.797 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.819 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.991 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.304 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.952 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.623 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.322 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.227 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.137 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.75 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.255 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.073 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.136 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.607 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.825 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.204 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.473 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.992 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.449 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.931 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.918 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.296 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.542 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.827 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.685 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.951 (ton-hours)  

Each handling stage has a fixed capacity in ton-hours that cannot be exceeded:  
* Stage 1’s total handling time must not exceed 134.677  
* Stage 2’s total handling time must not exceed 97.002  
* Stage 3’s total handling time must not exceed 155.373  
* Stage 4’s total handling time must not exceed 147.416  
* Stage 5’s total handling time must not exceed 196.741  
* Stage 6’s total handling time must not exceed 186.617  
* Stage 7’s total handling time must not exceed 120.81  

Given that the cumulative processing duration for every stage—Stage 1 through Stage 7—must remain within its allotted capacity, determine the optimal allocation of tonnage for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
